title: Axiom v0.1 eval question row
description: One eval row. A retrieved chunk counts as a hit for a gold span if, after collapsing all whitespace runs to single spaces on both sides, the chunk text contains the span. Category 'multi-chunk' means the evidence spans at least two retrieval chunks (same or different documents); it does not imply multi-hop reasoning. Category 'citation' means the answer must quote the passage exactly.

answerable.description: True if visible_docs contain sufficient evidence to answer.

expected.description: answer = grounded cited answer; abstain = explicit 'not enough evidence' plus missing_evidence.

visible_docs.description: Corpus files present in the requester's workspace. Retrieval must not use anything else.

forbidden_docs.description: Optional, isolation rows: documents that must appear in neither the retrieved set nor the citations. Failing the row if they do, even when the final answer abstains.

gold.description: Verbatim spans from pypdf extraction of the locked PDF's specified page (line breaks encoded as \n). Empty if and only if expected=abstain.

key_facts.description: Atomic facts a correct answer must contain; each must be entailed by the gold evidence.

missing_evidence.description: Required when expected=abstain: what input would be needed. Forbidden otherwise.
